item.title: Mother of Kerry boy in need of kidney transplant urges people to base organ donation decision on fact
item.description: Decisions on whether to opt-out of organ donation should be based on factual information from trusted sources. That’s the plea from the mother of Kerry boy Cíalan Walsh, who needs a kidney transplant. The nine-year-old, who's from Waterville, was born with a condition whereby he had only one functioning kidney. item.title: Brian Crowley remembered as gentleman and very effective politician
item.description: The late Ireland South MEP Brian Crowley has been remembered as a gentleman and a very effective politician. Brian Crowley passed away this morning at Cork University Hospital, aged 61. He represented the Munster and Ireland South constituencies, which include Kerry, as a member of the European Parliament between 1994 and 2019 for Fianna Fáil. item.title: Beaufort must wait seven more years for a wastewater treatment plant
item.description: It emerged in the Dáil this week that it will be seven years before a wastewater treatment plant will open in Beaufort. In December, the Department of Housing and Local Government increased the funding, allocated for the Beaufort plant, to seven million euro (€7million). It will connect to existing homes, and enable the construction of new homes, to safeguard water quality in the area. item.title: Lowry six off the lead
item.description: Shane Lowry is six shots off the lead at the midway point in the Dubai Desert Classic on the DP World Tour. A second-round 71 leaves him in a tie for 13th on three-under-par, alongside Tom McKibbin. Patrick Reed has a one-shot lead on nine-under, while Rory McIlroy is two-under for the tournament. item.title: Ireland captain to make 100th appearance for Leinster tomorrow
item.description: Ireland captain Caelan Doris will make his 100th appearance for Leinster in tomorrow's interpro derby away to Connacht in the URC. Prop Niall Smyth will make his debut, while Harry Byrne has been selected at out-half, and James Lowe returns on the wing. As for the hosts, Caolin Blade and Josh Ioane are back from injury to start in the half-backs. item.title: Rovers add another Ireland international to their squad
item.description: Shamrock Rovers have added another Republic of Ireland international to their squad ahead of the start of the Women's Premier Division. Ellen Molloy moves to Tallaght from Wexford, who confirmed her exit last Friday, just four days after announcing she would be staying for the 2026 season. Rovers begin their league campaign away to Cork City on Saturday March 14th. Advertisement

item.title: Kerry home support workers announce two strike dates in February
item.description: Health care assistants who provide home support in Kerry will take strike action on two dates in February. Kerry SIPTU members in the HSE home support service voted in favour of strike action earlier this month. It’s in relation to a dispute between health care assistants and their employers around national agreements on terms and conditions. item.title: Consultant in emergency medicine at UHK says wearing seat-belt saves lives and prevents serious injury
item.description: A Kerry consultant in emergency medicine says wearing a seat-belt can be the difference between walking away from a collision unharmed, or dying. Dr Martin Boyd is a consultant in emergency medicine at University Hospital Kerry. He says we often only hear about the fatalities, but people can also suffer life-long horrific injuries in crashes.
